bank_name: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd.

website_metadata.notes: ANZ India (anz.com/institutional/global/india) is an institutional & corporate banking branch only — transaction banking, markets, trade & supply chain, term financing. No retail/consumer term-deposit product and no public FD rate card. ANZ's term-deposit rate pages on anz.com.au / anz.co.nz are for Australia/NZ, not the India branch.

warnings: Foreign bank, India presence is wholesale/institutional only; no retail FD offered in India.
